apiKeys.revokeApiKeyName: Revoke API key "{name}"? Applications using it will immediately lose access. This cannot be undone.

appDetail.anyHostBindingFor: Any host binding for it should be released first. Applies on the next deploy.
appDetail.deleteReleaseVThis: Delete release v{version}? This removes its retired container and history.
appDetail.itStaysPublishedUntil: It stays published until the app is redeployed.
appDetail.redeployNowToFree: Redeploy now to free the host port?
appDetail.removeVarDeployed: The variable is removed from {name}. Applies on the next deploy.
appDetail.templateImage: {name} was installed from the “{template}” template. Changing its image here means it no longer matches the template, and a future template upgrade may overwrite your change. Upgrade through the marketplace when you can.
appDetail.templateImageVersioned: {name} was installed from the “{template}” template (v{version}). Changing its image here means it no longer matches the template, and a future template upgrade may overwrite your change. Upgrade through the marketplace when you can.
appDetail.theCanaryContainerIs: The canary container is stopped and discarded, and all traffic returns to the current stable release of {name}.
appDetail.theCanaryReleaseWill: The canary release will take 100% of traffic and become the stable release of {name}. The previous stable release is retired.
appDetail.thePortOnlyPublishes: The port only publishes on the next deploy. Redeploy now to publish it?

certificateDetail.deleteCertificateNameThis: Delete certificate "{name}"? This is blocked while a route still references it.

clusterDetail.eachWorkspaceNetworkIs: Each workspace network is converted from a node-local bridge to a cluster overlay, so apps and databases reach each other across nodes. Containers are NOT restarted, but connections open inside a workspace drop briefly while it switches over.
clusterDetail.removeNameFromThe: Remove {name} from the swarm? It becomes a standalone cluster of its own.
clusterDetail.theAgentIsRemoved:
The agent is removed from every cluster node. They keep running their tasks — Swarm schedules those itself — but Miabi loses its Docker connection to them.

Apps scheduled on those nodes will stop showing metrics, stats and a shell. The node records themselves are kept.

configs.deleteConfigNameAnd: Delete config "{name}" and its {length} file(s)? An application still mounting it blocks the delete.

databaseDetail.appsUsingThisDatabase: Apps using this database will lose connectivity until it is started again.
databaseDetail.deleteAllItsDatabases: Delete "{name}", all its databases, and its data volume? This cannot be undone.
databaseDetail.deleteBackupTheArtifact: Delete backup #{number}? The artifact will be removed.
databaseDetail.deleteDatabaseAndIts: Delete database "{name}" and its user? This cannot be undone.
databaseDetail.deleteItsDatabaseBackup: Delete {ref}? Its {length} database backup(s) and their artifacts are removed.
databaseDetail.restoreAllDatabaseS: Restore all {length} database(s) from {ref}? Their current contents are overwritten.
databaseDetail.theContainerWillBe: The {engine} container will be restarted. Brief downtime is expected.

databaseSizes.nameWillNoLonger: "{name}" will no longer be offered. Databases already on it keep their limits.

dnsProviders.disconnectNameExistingDns: Disconnect "{name}"? Existing DNS records are left untouched.
dnsProviders.enterOneOfYour: Enter one of your domains on {type} to test {name}.

domainDetail.banNameItsRoutes: Ban {name}? Its routes will be forced offline and it cannot be verified.
domainDetail.deleteDomainNameRoutes: Delete domain "{name}"? Routes using a host under it can no longer be created until it is re-added.
domainDetail.forceMarkNameAs: Force-mark {name} as verified without a DNS check? This bypasses ownership proof — use only for private or unreachable DNS.

domains.deleteDomainNameRoutes: Delete domain "{name}"? Routes using a host under it can no longer be created until it is re-added.

envVarModal.thisVariableHasUnsaved: This variable has unsaved changes. Closing now loses them.

gitOpsDetail.deleteAutoSync: Delete the live {kind} “{name}”. This removes the running resource now. This project auto-syncs, so it will be recreated from Git on the next reconcile.
gitOpsDetail.deleteManualSync: Delete the live {kind} “{name}”. This removes the running resource now. It stays gone until the next sync re-applies it from Git.

gitRepositories.deleteGitRepositoryName: Delete git repository "{name}"? Apps building from it will fail to clone.

imageDetail.deleteRepoNameThis: Delete {repo}:{name}? This removes the manifest from the registry and cannot be undone.

jobs.deleteCronjobScheduledRuns: Delete cronjob "{name}"? Scheduled runs will stop.
jobs.deleteJobRunThis: Delete job run #{id}? This cannot be undone.

ldapDirectory.deleteNameUsersProvisioned: Delete "{name}"? Users provisioned from it keep their accounts but can no longer sign in via this directory.

license.removeTheLicenseAnd: Remove the license and revert to Community Edition?

middlewareDetail.deleteMiddlewareNameRoutes: Delete middleware "{name}"? Routes referencing it will lose it.

middlewareFormModal.thisPolicyHasUnsaved: This policy has unsaved changes. Closing now loses them.

networks.deleteNetworkNameThis: Delete network "{name}"? This cannot be undone.

nodeDetail.removeContainerToremovecontainerThis: Remove container "{toRemoveContainer}"? This cannot be undone.
nodeDetail.removeNodeNameIts: Remove node "{name}"? Its agent tunnel is closed and the edge gateway (if any) is torn down.
nodeDetail.removeTheGomaGateway: Remove the Goma Gateway container from this node? Routing through it stops until you redeploy. ACME certs are preserved.
nodeDetail.swarmReschedulesThisNode:
Swarm reschedules this node's service tasks onto other nodes now, and places no new ones here. This is what makes the node safe to reboot.

Note: setting it back to Active does NOT move the tasks back. Swarm never rebalances on its own — they stay where they were rescheduled until a redeploy, a scale, or a drain of their new node moves them again.

oAuthProviders.deleteProviderNameThis: Delete provider "{name}"? This cannot be undone.

organizationDetail.displayNameWillBe: "{display_name}" will be removed, and any location dedicated to it becomes administrator-only until you reassign it. Deleting is refused while it still holds workspaces or users.

organizations.displayNameWillBe: "{display_name}" will be removed and any cluster dedicated to it returns to shared. Deleting is refused while it still holds workspaces or users — move those first.
organizations.newUsersAndWorkspaces: New users and workspaces that name no organization will belong to "{display_name}". Existing ones do not move.{promoteWarning}
organizations.promoteWarning: {name} runs its own locations ({where}), so new users and workspaces that name no organization will deploy there and nowhere else.

pipelines.delete: Delete pipeline "{name}"? Its run history is removed.
pipelines.deleteRepoOwned: Delete pipeline "{name}"? Its run history is removed, and its application goes back to building and deploying directly — skipping the steps in {path}.

planDetail.deletePlanNameAny: Delete plan "{name}"? Any workspaces using it will fall back to the default plan.

platformBackup.deletesTheRecoveryPoint: Deletes the recovery point and its artifacts from the bucket, including the identity envelope. This cannot be undone.
platformBackup.restore: Restore {what}? This is destructive. Put the platform in maintenance mode first. You also need the original MIABI_ENCRYPTION_KEY to decrypt restored secrets.

restoreWhat.database: the control-plane database (overwrites the running database in place)

platformBackup.schedulesAndCertificateIssuance: Schedules and certificate issuance resume. Do this only once DNS points at this host — otherwise certificate requests will be issued against an address that still resolves elsewhere.
platformBackup.thisOverwritesLiveData: This overwrites live data. {selectedCount} artifact(s) will be restored into this platform: databases are dropped and recreated from the backup, and volumes are overwritten. Data written since {created_at} is lost for whatever you selected.

portableBackupPanel.thisRemovesDeleterefFrom: This removes {deleteRef} from the bucket — its index, its state file and every dump and archive under it. It cannot be undone.

ports.hostPortHostPort: Host port {host_port}/{protocol} will not be published. The requester sees your note.

profile.signOutOthers: This will sign out all other devices and browsers. Continue?
profile.signOutThis: Sign this device out of your account? It will need to sign in again.

registries.deleteRegistryNameApps: Delete registry "{name}"? Apps using it will fail to pull private images.

registry.runGarbageCollectionThe: Run garbage collection? The registry switches to read-only (pulls keep working, pushes pause) while it reclaims space.

routeDetail.deleteRouteNameIts: Delete route "{name}"? Its hosts will stop routing to the app.

routeFormModal.thisRouteHasUnsaved: This route has unsaved changes. Closing now loses them.

routes.deleteRouteNameIts: Delete route "{name}"? Its hosts will stop routing to the app.
routes.reRenderEveryWorkspace: Re-render every workspace's gateway config from the database. Existing config files are rewritten in place (no downtime); routes already serving stay up. Continue?

runnerDetail.deleteRunnerNameIts: Delete runner “{name}”? Its container will no longer be able to connect, and any queued builds fall back to another runner.

runnersPanel.deleteRunnerNameIts: Delete runner “{name}”? Its container will no longer be able to connect, and any queued builds fall back to another runner.
runnersPanel.regenerateNameSToken: Regenerate {name}'s token? Its running container must be restarted with the new token.

secrets.deleteSecretNameApps: Delete secret "{name}"? Apps that reference it will fail to deploy until the reference is removed.

storageClasses.nameWillNoLonger: "{name}" will no longer be offered. Deleting is refused while any volume still uses it — disable it instead to stop new volumes landing there.

userDetail.disableSAccountThey: Disable {name}'s account? They will be signed out and unable to log in, and all their applications and databases will be stopped.
userDetail.disableTwoFactorAuthentication: Disable two-factor authentication for {name}? Use this only for account recovery.
userDetail.generateANewPassword: Generate a new password for {name}? This is irreversible: their current password stops working immediately, every active session is signed out, and the new password is shown only once.
userDetail.permanentlyDeleteAndAll: Permanently delete {name} and all of their remaining data right now? This skips the grace period and cannot be undone.

volumeDetail.deletePathFromThis: Delete "{path}" from this volume? This cannot be undone.
volumeDetail.deleteTheBackupTaken: Delete the backup taken {fmtTime}? The backup record is removed; the archive object in your S3 bucket is not deleted.
volumeDetail.deleteVolumeNameThis: Delete volume "{name}"? This permanently removes its data and cannot be undone.
volumeDetail.restoreNameFromThe: Restore "{name}" from the backup taken {fmtTime}? This overwrites the volume's current contents and cannot be undone.

webhooks.deleteWebhookUrlDelivery: Delete webhook "{url}"? Delivery history will be removed.

workspaceDetail.rotateTheEncryptionKey: Rotate the encryption key for "{name}"? Its secrets will be re-encrypted under a new key.
